featured.name: IoT Device Lifecycle & PKI Platform
featured.summary: Full-stack platform managing the complete lifecycle of IoT device identities: automated X.509 rotation, revocation and chain validation, with a real-time React dashboard spanning on-prem and Azure IoT Hub.
outcomes: Data staleness cut from minutes to <5s
Zero false positives in chain validation

highlights: Engineered and automated an MQTT-based provisioning system integrating TLS security and dynamic device IDs.
Collaborated with a team to enhance IoT device integration, ensuring scalability and reliability in real-time testing.

Architected and deployed a full-stack IoT device lifecycle management platform processing 12,000+ real X.509 certificates, implementing automated certificate rotation, revocation, and chain validation with custom PKI test suites.
Built a real-time React dashboard visualizing device security posture across hybrid environments (On-Prem + Azure IoT Hub), reducing data staleness from minutes to under 5 seconds.

Developed an embedded cryptographic verification pipeline in C#/.NET 8 performing real X.509 chain validation, mTLS handshake simulation, and CRL generation, detecting security anomalies with zero false positives.
Developed and deployed TinyML models on NodeMCU for IoT applications, optimizing algorithms for low-power microcontrollers.
Designed predictive models for anomaly detection and pattern recognition, improving system efficiency.
